name: ca.dentalcostfinder/canada-dental

description: Estimate Canadian dental costs, check CDCP eligibility, and find dental pricing guides by city.

tools.name: estimate_dental_procedure_cost

procedure.description: Procedure key: dental-cleaning, filling, toothache-emergency, tooth-extraction, wisdom-teeth, root-canal, dental-crown, dental-implant, invisalign, braces, teeth-whitening, pediatric-dentist.

tools.name: check_cdcp_coverage
tools.description: Check Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP) eligibility, co-payment tier by adjusted family net income, and covered dental services.

adjustedFamilyNetIncome.description: Adjusted family net income in CAD from the latest CRA tax return.

hasPrivateInsurance.description: Whether the applicant has access to private or employer dental insurance.

isCanadianTaxResident.description: Whether the applicant is a Canadian resident for tax purposes and filed a return.
